ns2:section.sectionText: This course introduces spacecraft assembly and integration activities, including modeling, simulation, and test. As part of this introduction, students will gain hands-on experience designing and developing the Laboratory for Advanced Space Systems at Illinois’ (LASSI) hardware in the loop Integrated Test System (ITS). The ITS will be used for verification and validation of future spacecraft developed at LASSI. Knowledge of orbital mechanics, control systems, electronics, and/or software is helpful, but not required.
